units.source_text: 参加贺茂祭的人，头上皆插葵花或桂花。

en.t: Those who took part in the Kamo Festival all wore hollyhock or katsura flowers in their hair.
In Japanese, aoi, meaning hollyhock, has the same sound as au, meaning to meet.

units.source_text: 说不清葵花之名，意思是说后会之期不可知。

en.t: The uncertainty over the name of the hollyhock means that the time of a later meeting cannot be known.
